parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO automation.device_profile AS d (enrollment_id, profile_name, version, state, claimed_at)
  SELECT $1, p.name, p.version, 'claimed', now()
  FROM automation.profile_state p
  WHERE p.enabled
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.enrollments e WHERE e.id = $1 AND e.enabled)
  ON CONFLICT (enrollment_id, profile_name) DO UPDATE
    SET version = EXCLUDED.version, state = 'claimed', claimed_at = now(), command_uuid = NULL, sent_at = NULL
    WHERE d.version < EXCLUDED.version
       OR d.state = 'failed'
       OR (d.state = 'claimed' AND d.claimed_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
  RETURNING d.enrollment_id, d.profile_name, d.version
)
SELECT c.enrollment_id, c.profile_name, c.version, p.template, p.params
FROM claimed c JOIN automation.profile_state p ON p.name = c.profile_name

UPDATE automation.device_profile
SET state = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    command_uuid = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN $3 ELSE NULL END,
    sent_at = now()
WHERE enrollment_id = $1 AND profile_name = $2
RETURNING enrollment_id, profile_name, state, $5::text AS detail

UPDATE automation.device_profile
SET state = CASE WHEN $2 = 'Acknowledged' THEN 'installed' ELSE 'error' END
WHERE command_uuid = $1 AND state = 'queued'
RETURNING enrollment_id, profile_name, state

meta.description: Empfaengt NanoMDM-Webhooks. Bei TokenUpdate eines Geraets werden alle aktiven Basisprofile aus automation.profile_state einmalig per InstallProfile eingereiht (idempotent ueber automation.device_profile). Quittungen (mdm.Connect) setzen den Status auf installed bzw. error. Der Webhook-Pfad enthaelt das Token aus dem SealedSecret mdm-secrets (Schluessel webhook-token); mdm-n8n-setup.sh ersetzt __WEBHOOK_TOKEN__ beim Import. Credentials: MDM NanoMDM API (Basic Auth, Benutzer nanomdm), MDM Automation DB (Postgres), ntfy-publisher.
